recipes.title: Cauliflower Protein Chicken Alfredo
steps: Boil the cauliflower until very soft — overcooking it makes the creamiest sauce.
Blend the cauliflower with the Parmesan, Pecorino, garlic, skim milk, salt and pepper until silky.
Season and sear the chicken in a hot pan until golden and cooked through. Rest and slice.
Cook the fettuccine, then toss it in a pan with the sauce until coated.
Top with the sliced chicken and extra grated cheese.
recipes.notes: Sauce amounts are from the video; per-serving macros are from the on-screen card. The cauliflower, pasta and chicken amounts and the 2 servings are estimates.
